mapper.select: select resource_type as resourceType, count(*) as totalCount, sum(case when status = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as availableCount from resource group by resource_type order by resource_type

select r.id, r.resource_code, r.resource_name, r.resource_type, r.status, r.floor, r.open_time, r.description, r.create_time, r.update_time from resource r
and r.status = 1
and r.resource_type = #{resourceType}
and not exists ( select 1 from reservation rs where rs.resource_id = r.id and rs.reserve_date = #{reserveDate} and rs.status = 2 and rs.start_time < #{endTime} and rs.end_time > #{startTime} )
order by r.update_time desc
